posts.text: Fixed a race in the worker pool: two jobs shared one page because the pool wasn't awaiting lock release. Always await release() before handing the slot back.
Shipped Task 2 of the worker pool plan.
Decided to use cursor pagination instead of offset for the feed endpoint; offset scans got slow past fifty thousand rows and skipped items when new posts arrived.
Completed the feed query refactor.
Gotcha: JWT verification failed for tokens issued by the old auth service because its clock ran ahead; we now allow 30 seconds of clock skew instead of zero.
WIP on the auth middleware.
The rate limiter keys on API key plus route, not client IP, because customers behind one corporate NAT were throttling each other.
Lesson from the orders migration: add new columns as nullable, backfill in batches, then add NOT NULL. Adding NOT NULL with a default locked the orders table for eight minutes.
Task 5 done for the billing webhooks plan.
Payment webhooks are retried with exponential backoff and deduplicated by event id, because the payment provider redelivers events after timeouts and we applied one refund twice.
Working on the invoice export.
The product cache uses a five minute TTL plus explicit invalidation on update; the TTL alone served stale prices for up to an hour after edits.
Shipped the healthcheck endpoint.
Decided against client-side price calculation in checkout because rounding differed from the server and totals were off by a cent; the cart now always shows the server total.
Shipped Task 3 of the checkout plan.
WIP on the checkout page.
Done with the checkout copy changes.
Completed task 4 of the checkout plan.
Hydration mismatch in the date picker: the server rendered UTC and the browser rendered local time. Root cause was formatting dates during render; we now format after mount.
Finished the date picker styling.
Bundle size dropped 40 percent after moving the charting library to a dynamic import; it was pulled into every page because the root layout imported it.
Gotcha: remote product images need their host listed in the image config, otherwise the optimizer returns 400 in production only.
Form validation runs the same schema on client and server so error messages match; we dropped the separate client rules because they drifted from the server ones.
Shipped the new button styles.
WIP on the dashboard.
CI went from eleven to four minutes after keying the package store cache on the lockfile hash instead of the branch name, which missed on every new branch.
Shipped Task 1 of the CI cleanup.
Decided to drop the import-order lint rule because its autofix fought with the formatter and produced noisy diffs in every pull request.
Root cause of the flaky timeout in the integration suite: tests shared one database file. Each test worker now gets its own temporary database.
Completed the release script update.
The release script tags only after the build succeeds, because a failed build once left a tag pointing at an unbuilt commit and broke installs.
The shared API client now retries 502 responses from acme-api twice, because its load balancer drops connections during deploys.
Done with the codegen bump.
Pre-commit only lints staged files; running the full lint there made commits take forty seconds and people started skipping hooks.
Connection pool exhaustion in production: the root cause was a default pool of twenty connections per pod times thirty pods, above the database limit. Pool size is now five per pod.
Shipped the postgres config change.
Backups are verified by restoring into a scratch database every night; an untested backup turned out to be empty for two weeks last quarter.
DNS changes took an hour to propagate because the old record had a one hour TTL; lower the TTL a day before any migration.
Task 7 done for the DNS migration.
Disk alerts now fire at 80 percent instead of 95, because the log volume fills faster than on-call can respond at night.
Starting the alert tuning.
Build artifacts move to cold storage after thirty days; storage costs were mostly old artifacts nobody downloaded.
